D OCUMENTARY EVIDENCE MUST BE SUBMITTED. b)Bidder financial standing and non banning: The bidder must not have suffere d bankruptcy/insolvency, under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings during the last 5 years. The bidder should not have been banned or debarred by any Central/ State Government/ agency of Central/ State Government/ Public Sector Unde rtaking/ Regulatory Authority of India at the time of submission of this bid. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. c) DETAILS OF VEHICLE: One Vehicle (AC SUV) should be registered in the name of Tenderer and should not sublet any part of the contract. However, the tenderer ca n have Lease Agreement with the owner of the vehicle/cab aggregator on non-judicia l stamp paper for the tenure of the contract, which should be submitted along with th e bid. The vehicle proposed to be offered on hire should be in good condition and not more than 04 years old, on the date of opening of tender. The vehicles provided for s ervice should be registered as a Commercial vehicle. The tenderer is required to sub mit the COMMERCIAL VEHICLE REGISTRATION DETAILS along with supporting docume nts of the vehicle fulfilling the category, specifications along with the tender, failing t o submit the same along with the bid, the offer will be summarily rejected. Bids of ot her than commercial vehicles should be summarily rejected. The vehicle should be re gistered in the state of Telangana. If the bidder offers a vehicle registered in the stat e other than Telangana, then valid RTO permit of plying the vehicle in Telangana or A LL INDIA PERMIT to be mandatorily uploaded with the bid offer. Bids of commercial v ehicles registered in any state other than Telangana state (without valid RTO permit of plying the vehicle in Telangana or ALL INDIA PERMIT) will be summarily rejected. d) PERFORMANCE DETAILS: Along with tender, bidders to enclose the list of ongoi ng vehicles hire contracts with Railways, Other Central Government Departments, St ate Government and PSUs in the same city/location/agglomeration with details of Co ntract Period, rate per month, Vehicle Class, Model and brand, Fuel (Diesel/Petrol/ LP G/CNG/Electric/Hybrid), procurement cost (ex-showroom price) etc. Submission of thi s statement, even if Nil, shall be mandatory enclosure to the tender failing which the

offer will be summarily rejected. Annexure-III should be uploaded with the bid duly si gned and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rejected wi thout making any back reference. [ Proforma as per Annexure-III of Buyer uplo aded ATC document]. e) SUBMISSION OF UNDERTAKING CERTIFYING THE TRUTHFULNESS OF ALL THE DOCUMENTS: The bidders shall submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulne ss of all the documents submitted / uploaded along with the tender. This shall be ma ndatory for all the bidders. In case of failure of the bidder to submit the undertaking, t heir offer shall be summarily rejected. Annexure-I should be uploaded with the bid du ly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rejecte d without making any back reference. [Proforma as per Annexure-I of Buyer upl oaded ATC document] f) DECLARATION OF THE DETAILS OF THE ENGAGEMENT OF RETIRED/EXISTIN G RAILWAY EMPLOYEES: Declaration regarding site visit, compliance of statutory l aws, penalty for violation of labour laws, non blacklisting, termination of contracts etc . Self-declaration of the undertaking by the bidder that my/our firm/ Company is not u nder liquidation court receivership or similar proceedings and has not suffered bankr uptcy/insolvency during the last 5 years. Annexure- IV should be up loaded with the b id duly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rej ected without making any back reference. [Proforma as per Annexure -IV of Buy er uploaded ATC document]. g) CONSTITUTION OF FIRM: The bidder shall give full details of the constitution of the Firm/Company/Society etc. and shall also submit following documents (as applica ble), in addition to documents mentioned above. (i) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarized copy of the affidavi t and GST certificate indicating Proprietorship certificate. (ii) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (A)Registered/notarized Partnership Deed; and (B) Power of Attorney duly authorising one or more of the partners of the firm or any other persons, authorised by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements, sign Measurement Books, receive payment, make correspondences, compromise/s ettle/ relinquish any claim(s) preferred by the firm, sign 'No Claim certificate', r efer all or any dispute to arbitration and to take similar action in respect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. (iii) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall submit (A) The copies of MOA (Memorandum of Association) and AOA (Articles of Asso ciation) of the Company; and (B) Power of Attorney duly registered/notarized by the company (backed by th e resolution of Board of Directors) in favour of the individual, signing the Bid on

behalf of the Company. (iv) Society: The bidder shall submit (A)Self- attested copy of the certificate of Registration; (B) Deed of Formation; and (C) Power of Attorney in favour of the tender signatory. (v) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Venture (JV) not permitted /not allowed in this tender Bidd er's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documen ts sought in the Bid document. Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms and Condit ions and Corrigendum if any. Note :Post tender opening no new documents (which are not part of original bid offer uploaded by bidder before opening of GeM bid) will be considered for bid e valuation. Bidder's offer is summarily to be rejected if they don't upload any of t he certificates / documents sought in the Eligibility criteria and Corrigendum if a ny. 3) SPECIAL CONDITIONS: a) GST Compliance: The contractor/agency participating in the tender should norm ally be GST compliant regarding registration, filing of returns etc., and shall be fully r esponsible for the compliance as per GST Act at all times. If the Contractor falls eithe r “below the turnover threshold for GST” or is a “Composition Taxable Person” under the CGST Act, a self-declaration should be enclosed with his offer duly supported by a certificate of turnover from a Chartered Accountant or enclose Form ‘REG06’ showi ng as “Composition” under Type of Registration and no GST is applicable for contract s with such persons/firms. GST for vehicle rental/hire services falls under SAC code 9 966, as per which, the present applicable rate is 5% (2.5% CGST+2.5% SGST) for veh icles designed to carry men and materials where cost of fuel is included in the rate. b) Vehicle Requirements: It should have a “Valid Fitness certificate/commercial lic ense” (Permit for Commercial Vehicle shall cover all States in S.C. Railway jurisdictio n or as considered necessary by the Department/ Division/ Unit calling the tender fro m appropriate Regional Road Transport Authority of the concerned State Govt./Union Territory), valid insurance and should meet requirements of pollution standard, etc. a s per provisions of Motor Vehicle Act and fulfil any other statutory obligations as appli cable including all safety approved accessories/ equipment fitted to the vehicles. Onc e the contract is awarded, the service provider needs to submit Driver’s details to the Consignee and driver should have passed a minimum of 10th standard and possess a valid driving licence, Aadhar Card on his name and an employee id notification card issued by the Contractor at all times. The contractor should attest to the driver’s poli ce verification as per the existing procedure. The verification of driver details, driving license, Aadhar Card etc. has to be done by the consignee. c) Availability: The vehicles should be available on all days including holidays as pe r requirement of the user for official duty.

d) Standards for Substitute Vehicles: In reference to SLA clause no.5.11 and 5.1 2, the substitute vehicles offered shall not be older than the vehicle under breakdow n at any point of time during the currency of contract. The condition and upkeep of s ubstitute vehicles shall be the same as that of approved vehicles in the contract. e) Operational Availability and Payment Terms: The contractor shall be respons ible for providing the vehicles at any point of time in day or night, even at short notic e during any urgency/emergency. Hiring for 12 hours in a day means continuous hirin g for 12 hours during day or 12 hours during night. No advance payment shall be ma de and all payments released on completion of stipulated service periodically/monthl y as stipulated. In case, on any day, the vehicle was utilized for more than 12 hours o n exceptional/ emergency requirement, relaxation to that extent may be provided in subsequent days to the Contractor/firm. f) Vehicle Upkeep and Driver Conduct: The vehicles should be mechanically sou nd and shall be well maintained with neat and clean interiors/exteriors. The driver sh ould display good behaviour and be neatly dressed. Smoking and use of cell phones during driving is prohibited. It is desirable that drivers should wear proper, neat, and clean formal uniforms with shoes. g) Compliance with Labour Laws: Contractor shall be responsible for ensuring co mpliance with the provisions related to Labour Laws (Central/State) as applicable fro m time to time. The employees of the Contractor shall not be deemed to be employe es of the user department/Railway. Hence the compliance of the applicable Acts/Laws will be the sole responsibility of the Contractor. h) Breakdown Maintenance and Arrangements: In the event of any breakdown, servicing, and repairs of vehicles, the Contractor at his own cost shall make alternate arrangements by providing a similar or higher class of commercial vehicle(s) for whic h the contract is entered into. The substitute vehicle offered shall not be older than t he vehicles under breakdown at any point of time during the currency of the contract . Maintenance works on vehicles should be done during off-duty hours by the Contrac tor. i) Liability, Penalties, and Contingency Planning: The Contractor shall be fully r esponsible for any repair, accident, loss, or damage to the vehicle and driver. If any fi ne or penalty is imposed by various authorities such as RTA, Traffic Police etc for any violation such as speed, traffic rules violation, etc, the same will have to be borne by the Contractor only. The contractor shall provide a detailed contingency plan (in the event of mechanical breakdown etc.) for each vehicle supplied for each area of opera tion. j) Staff Verification and Fitness: The service provider would be bound by the con ditions regarding police verification of the deployed staff and their medical fitness. k) Governing Penalties: Imposition of penalties is as per Para 8 of GeM SLA. l) Kilo-meter and Hour Variations: The SLA clause 4.2 sub clause (1) & (2) for pay ment of extra kilo meter and extra hours shall not be applicable to this contract. In a ny month, vehicle run can be more or less than the scale of Number of 2000 KM/mon th but shall not exceed cumulative KM 24,000 per year for SUV AC. Payment will be made on a monthly basis as per accepted monthly rate irrespective of actual KM run

in that month. No further variation in KM is either allowed or to be paid. The rate quo ted shall be inclusive of salary of driver, daily battha, fuel, petrol/diesel, other consu mables, regular maintenance, expenses and other expenditure towards repairs, taxe s etc. m) Price Variation: Price variation Clause is not applicable in this tender. n) Maintenance and Verification of Log Books: A Log Book for each vehicle shall be maintained by the Contractor for the hired vehicles. The KM utilised shall be enter ed in it on a daily basis to ensure proper account and payment at the end of every m onth /specified period. It is the responsibility of the official using the vehicle to keep t he log book up to date and the vehicle is used for the official duties/works. Statemen t of entries as per Log Book should be enclosed with the bills submitted for payment by the service provider/contractor duly counter signed by the official to who/under w hose custody the vehicle is placed except that in case of vehicles hired for DRMs/PHO Ds/AGM/ GM, this statement shall be count assigned by nominated officer in the secr etariat. In case of pooled vehicles, Secretary to PHOD or ADRM or nominated in charg e Gazetted Officer will sign the Log Book/statement sent with bills thereof, as the cas e may be. o) Short-Closure and Termination of Contract: The vehicle contract can be shor t-closed with three-month notice, if the post of the officer is surrendered or the officer opts for drawl of transport allowance or any other administrative reason (exce pt unsatisfactory service, which will be as per penalty clause of SLA). In this regard, t he following conditions will be applicable: (i) The Railway has liberty to short-close the contract with any or all of the serv ice providers normally with three months' notice without assigning any reason. However, in case a service provider wants to short-close his services, he will h ave to serve 4 months advance written notice. (ii) The contract for the vehicles hired can also be terminated with a short noti ce of 15 days on account of unsatisfactory services at the discretion of the Offi cer in charge of hiring of vehicles. The unsatisfactory service shall mean and in clude the non-compliance of any of the obligations by the service provider, as given in this agreement and/or under the penalty clauses of the SLA or GeM co ntract or repeated breach. PG of the service provider will be forfeited in the ca se of breach of SLA where the breach is not capable of remedy and the contrac t is terminated. (iii) In case of any dispute of any kind, the Contractor/ Agency shall abide by th e decision of the controlling authority or Nodal Officer or Buyer in charge of hiri ng of the vehicle as the case may be. p) Performance Security and Guarantee Rules: Successful Bidders have to sub mit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt /Performance bank Guarantee (Bank Guarantee sample format as per Annexure-II of scope of work docu ment). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/HYB (Name of the Service Provider). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn onl y on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the buyer after making endorsement o n the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with a covering letter. Successf

ul Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has t o ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the buyer within 30 days of award o f bid in GeM/date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security. The GeM co ntract will be issued only after receipt of Performance Security. Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 30 days and up to the date of submission of PG from the da te of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security may be given by Sr.DMM/HY B However, a penal interest of 15 % per annum shall be charged for the delay beyon d 30 days (i.e. from 31st day after the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performa nce Security. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG after 60 days fro m the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security, a notice shall be s erved to the contractor to deposit PG immediately however not exceeding 90 days fr om date of intimation. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even aft er 90 days from the date of intimation, a notice shall be served to the contractor and the GeM Bid shall be cancelled duly forfeiting EMD and other dues, if any payable ag ainst the tender. The failed Service Provider shall be debarred from participating in r e-tender for that service. In case, 60th day is a bank holiday or office closure next wo rking day should be considered as the last day for submission of PGs, Decision of Sr. DMM/HYB would be final in case of any dispute. q) Assignment and Sub-contracting: (i) The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining th e prior written consent of the buyer; (ii) The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of the buyer; and (iii) The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to the buyer together with t he assignee/sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the C ontract and the Seller’s obligations thereunder. r) Performance-Based Rejection: The Service provider having non-satisfactory/ba d performance in previously completed contracts or current live contracts may be rej ected. s) Consistency of Deployed Vehicles and Replacement Rules: The vehicle doc uments which were uploaded in the bidding process should be kept in service along with the Number, Model and type of vehicles after approval of consignee. In case, the condition of vehicles is not satisfactory or requires replacement due to any other rea son, service provider has to replace the vehicles with same segment or higher segme nt commercial vehicle’s, mentioned in GeM SLA, as per bid conditions with approval of user/consignee. t) Daily Vehicle Availability, Parking, and Fuel Minimums: The vehicles should be available every day at nominated time and place as per the directions of ADRM/H YB given from time to time. Vehicles shall/Can be parked in the Railway premises/ Re sidence during night time for emergency use as per direction of ADRM/HYB the Vehi cle keys should be submitted to the officer/authorized representative after duty hour s, in case any emergency officer can use the vehicle. Minimum 30% of fuel tank capa city should be in the vehicle all the time. In case of any dispute, the decision of Sr.DM M/HYB shall be binding regarding placement and usage of vehicle for contract.

u) GeM Billing and Invoice Processing Procedure: The bills will be submitted t hrough the GeM Portal by Seller. The Seller has to prepare a draft Seller In voice and submit it to the Consignee for verification and levy of penalty, if any. After verificatio n of Consignee, Seller shall generate final Seller invoice with penalty (if any) and uplo ad/attach copy of Log Book, Penalty advice from Consignee, Fund certification from C onsignee etc with final Seller invoice and finally generate GeM Seller Invoice. The Co nsignee shall ensure generation of Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate (SDAC) an d verify the penalty etc, if any. If the invoice generated by Seller, mismatches with co ntract/ the amount of penalty imposed / document stated above, the Consignee shall return the Seller GeM invoice in GeM itself suggesting the corrections. If the Seller Ge M invoice and Seller Invoice is correct, then, SDAC shall be generated within 7 workin g days from the date of GeM seller invoice date, else GeM will auto-generate SDAC a nd populate the bill to Consignee for forwarding to Paying authority. The Bill Passing officer is Sr.DMM/HYB and the Bill Paying Officer is Sr.DFM/HYB. .
